analysis.summary: Management reported steady progress in the offshore services sector, supported by rising asset utilization, international expansion via subsidiaries like Beluga International, and disciplined asset deployment. The company highlighted ongoing operations of the Prabha DP2 Accommodation Barge and a focus on expanding its marine fleet capabilities including AHTS and PSVs. Standalone net profit for the year rose significantly to 3,753.55 Lakhs, while consolidated revenue grew to 11,642.04 Lakhs. The Board decided to retain current year profits for planned capital expenditures and did not recommend a dividend. Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited submitted its Annual Report for 2024-25, highlighting financial results, operational updates, and committee appointments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that global offshore oil and gas activity continues to strengthen, supported by sustained investments in energy security and deepwater developments.
demand_outlook.quote: Global offshore oil and gas activity continues to strengthen, supported by sustained investments in energy security, increasing deepwater developments, and the need to offset production declines from mature fields.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that demand for offshore support vessels, accommodation barges, diving support vessels and subsea service providers continues to be supported by ongoing project sanctions.
demand_outlook.quote: These trends are supporting demand for offshore support vessels, accommodation barges, diving support vessels and subsea service providers.

demand_outlook.claim: The offshore support vessel market remains in an upcycle driven by higher offshore capital expenditure, improving utilization levels and constrained vessel supply.
demand_outlook.quote: The offshore support vessel market remains in an upcycle driven by higher offshore capital expenditure, improving utilization levels and constrained vessel supply.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported that Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) are currently in high demand due to increased activity on offshore oil and gas platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) are currently in high demand due to increased activity on offshore oil and gas platforms.

demand_outlook.claim: The medium-term outlook for the offshore services sector remains favourable, supported by sustained offshore investment and increasing demand for specialised marine assets.
demand_outlook.quote: The medium-term outlook for the offshore services sector remains favourable, supported by sustained offshore investment, increasing demand for specialised marine assets and limited fleet additions.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that contract tenures for Platform Supply Vessels and Anchor Handling Tug Supply vessels generally range from one to five years, offering stable revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: The contract tenures for Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) and Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS) vessels generally range from 1 to 5 years, providing Dolphin Offshore Enterprises with a stable and predictable revenue stream.

demand_outlook.claim: The market is expected to remain buoyant as ONGC proposes high-value tenders in brown and green fields.
demand_outlook.quote: The market is expected to remain buoyant in the coming years as ONGC proposes to come out with many high value tenders in brown & green fields.

demand_outlook.claim: Platform Supply Vessels are in high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: PSV are in high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.

capex_expansion.claim: The company stated it is planning for acquiring new vessels depending on the proximity of contract.
capex_expansion.quote: In response to this market opportunity, Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning for acquiring new vessels depending on the proximity of contract.

capex_expansion.claim: Strategic expansion in vessels will be financed through a combination of debt and equity.
capex_expansion.quote: This strategic expansion will be financed through a combination of debt and equity, aligning with the company’s growth ambitions and current market dynamics.

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced plans for a capital investment of approximately 500 crore rupees over the next 12 to 15 months to acquire two DSVs/PSVs and two Anchor Handling Tug Supply vessels.
capex_expansion.quote: In response to this market opportunity, Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning a capital investment of approximately ₹500 crore over the next 12 to 15 months to acquire two DSVs/PSVs & two Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS) vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: Beluga International DMCC was incorporated for ship charter activities including renting and leasing of water-transport boats, barges, and tugs.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company is incorporated for the purpose of carrying out the activities relating to ship charter including renting and leasing of water-transport boats, Barges & Tugs and for passenger transport or cargo, whether owned by the company or being re-chartered.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone revenues from operations stood at 1,173.25 Lakhs for the year under review compared to 1,488.48 Lakhs in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, the Company’s Standalone revenues from operations stood at ₹ 1,173.25 Lakhs as compared to ₹ 1,488.48 Lakhs in the previous year, while consolidated revenues from operations increased to ₹ 11,642.04 Lakhs as compared to ₹ 7,401.92 Lakhs in the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone net profit for the company increased to 3,753.55 Lakhs compared to 324.16 Lakhs in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The Company’s Standalone net profit was increased to ₹ 3,753.55 Lakhs as compared to ₹ 324.16 Lakhs in the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the Prabha DP2 Accommodation Work Barge has a capacity of 275 people, deck space of 1200 square meters, and a 330-ton crane.
orders_capacity.quote: Prabha is a Dynamically Positioned Vessel (DP2) accommodation Work Barge with a capacity of 275 People, Deck Space of 1200 sq. meter and 330-ton crane and the same is owned by Beluga International DMCC, UAE which is 100% subsidiary of DOEIL.

orders_capacity.claim: Contract tenures for Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) and Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS) vessels generally range from 1 to 5 years.
orders_capacity.quote: The contract tenures for Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) and Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS) vessels generally range from 1 to 5 years, providing Dolphin Offshore Enterprises with a stable and predictable revenue stream.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued 8,42,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each through a qualified institutions placement.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has issued 8,42,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each to eligible qualified institutional buyers through a qualified institutions placement under Chapter VI of the SEBI ICDR Regulations.

capital_allocation.claim: The company sub-divided one equity share of face value Rs. 10 into 10 equity shares of face value Rs. 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has sub-divided 1(One) Equity Share having nominal/face value of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten Only) into 10 (Ten) Equity Shares having nominal/face value of Rs. 1/- (Rupees One Only) each.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted geopolitical risks such as political unrest and war in the Middle East resulting in the closure of the Straits of Hormuz and disruptions in production.
risks_headwinds.quote: political unrest and war in the Middle East resulting in closure of the Straits of Hormuz and disruptions in productions from oil and gas fields and refineries..

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified volatility in oil prices, economic downturns, operational hazards, weather conditions, and cybersecurity threats as key risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks span various areas, including financial, operational, environmental, regulatory, and reputational aspects.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that offshore vessels heavily rely on the oil and gas industry, and fluctuations in oil prices can reduce demand and profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in Oil Prices: Offshore vessels heavily rely on the oil and gas industry. Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels, affecting profitability.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management flagged that adverse weather and harsh sea conditions can disrupt operations, damage vessels, and pose safety risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Weather and Sea Conditions: Adverse weather and harsh sea conditions can disrupt operations, damage vessels, and pose safety risks to crew members.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that offshore vessels are expensive to build and maintain, requiring significant capital investment and financing challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: High Capital Costs: Offshore vessels are expensive to build and maintain, requiring significant capital investment. Financing these assets can be challenging, especially during downturns.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels and affect profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels, affecting profitability.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated approval of the members is sought for related party transactions during the conclusion of the 47th Annual General Meeting till the conclusion of the 48th Annual General Meeting to be held in the financial year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Approval of the Members is being sought for transactions during the conclusion of 47th Annual General Meeting of the Company till the conclusion of 48th Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held in the financial year 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans a capital investment of approximately 500 crore rupees over the next 12 to 15 months to acquire specific vessels.
management_commitments.quote: In response to this market opportunity, Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning a capital investment of approximately ₹500 crore over the next 12 to 15 months to acquire two DSVs/PSVs & two Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS) vessels.

management_commitments.claim: The company seeks member approval for related party transactions for three financial years from 2024-25 till 2026-27.
management_commitments.quote: Approval of the Board is being sought for transactions during the Three (3) Financial years (i.e. from 2024-25 till Financial Year 2026-27)
